scenes.spoken_text: An integrated media-unit package connects viewing needs, equipment, structure, services, quantities and inspection. Make every change traceable across the documents it affects.
scenes.caption: An integrated media-unit package connects viewing needs, equipment, structure, services, quantities and inspection. Make every change traceable across the documents it affects.

scenes.display_title: Freeze the project brief and references
scenes.spoken_text: Record users, viewing position, device models, storage and site survey. Separate confirmed data from assumptions; an unselected device size must not become a manufacturing release. Refer back to screen and unit decisions, and assign substrate, fixing and service reviews. An attractive elevation does not establish equipment compatibility or wall suitability.
scenes.caption: Show unresolved inputs explicitly before drawing release.

scenes.spoken_text: Use the same unit codes in plan, elevation, section and parts list. Show structure, finish build-up and service paths, linking materials to products, samples and edges. A deeper device may affect the compartment, back, cable space, shelf and cut parts. Update affected documents under one revision; changing only the presentation elevation leaves a conflicting package.
scenes.caption: One change can affect several coordinated documents.

scenes.spoken_text: Plan delivery, assembly and fixing/service checks before closure. Assign references and reviewers for motion, alignment, finish, ventilation and maintenance access. Secure equipment and furniture using the approved system and substrate conditions; weight alone does not prove tip-over resistance. Handover includes final drawings, product identities, care instructions and outstanding items.
scenes.caption: A coordinated package includes evidence and unresolved items.

scenes.spoken_text: A deeper device replaces the selected model after the elevation is approved. Review section, connections, ventilation and affected parts, then issue a coordinated revision. The finish sample may remain valid if that system is unchanged, but it does not establish that the new equipment fits. Decision: revise affected documents and verify them before production release.
scenes.caption: Decision: revise affected documents and verify them before production release.

scenes.display_title: Prepare the package index, a device-change record and three referenced inspection items.
scenes.spoken_text: Prepare the package index, a device-change record and three referenced inspection items.
